set.body:
Owner-only dispositions still open (governing: PLAN.md §6; B0 analysis in plan b12f79c §9.1, ratified 2026-08-30). Nobody accepts terms on the owner's behalf.
1. pyannote.audio: accept or decline the gated Hugging Face terms (needed only if diarization enters an AV evidence profile).
2. MF2 (NC-SA, research-only): include or exclude. It stays excluded from defaults until decided.
4. FilmFestival: participant-content and REB basis for the viewed film editions.
5. Any other human recall corpus: an owner-recorded REB and redistribution basis before recall bytes, prose, excerpts, provider logs or derived text enter git.
Resolved: item 3 (Sherlock; owner policy 2026-09-01: only raw video bytes are excluded).
Acceptance: a recorded decision note per open item. None of these gates the local annotation-assisted Sherlock preview.
